observations.claim: All 5 generated candidates adopted decoupled depot-start and dimensionless scoring, but best generated (-0.0615) trailed incumbent Frozen_C (-0.1089) because candidates 1/2/4/5 used oversized beta_fill=0.30-0.40 against d_cur/scale~0.10 while candidate 2/3 inverted signs.

hypotheses.claim: H-004: Calibrating mid-route beta_fill to 0.05-0.18 and adding a scale-invariant voluntary early-return gate (return depot when normalized saving sigma(i,j)=(d0i+d0j-dij)/(d0i+d0j)<tau) eliminates cross-depot deadhead bridges and beats incumbent C (-0.1089) while staying scale-invariant across n=50/100/200.

next_search_advice.direction: Tighten beta_fill to 0.05-0.18, keep decoupled depot-start and strict scale invariance, and introduce voluntary early-return to depot via normalized saving threshold tau in [0.15, 0.35].
